_note: Tanımlı 2-karakter karşılaşmaları. mode:'pc' = PC ile karşılaşma (haritada TEK avatar, biz konuşuruz, seçim bizim); mode:'npc' = iki NPC, biz izleriz. who: pc→[charId] (tek), npc→[a,b]. type=whisper|gossip|question|love (ikon). script = episode DSL (Situation / [cast] / [ui:narrative|bubble|multi] / Narrative: / Speaker: / (Choice:N)/(IfChoice)/(EndIf) / Mechanics: (Relation:id|trust|+n)(XP:id|+n)(Scandal:+n)(Allure:+n)(Discovery:id|fact)(Unlock:loc)). once=bir kez. Oyun: pc→tek avatar+ikon; npc→çift+ikon; tap → pridePlayEncounter (map kararır, episode dialog UI). Editörden düzenlenir.

encounters.script:
(Situation: enc_darcy | On the Lane | Mr Darcy blocks your path)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Mr Darcy stands square in the lane, as if he had been waiting — though he would never own to it.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=arabella_frost right=mr_darcy]
Mr-Darcy: Miss Frost. You walk out early.
Arabella: Earlier than is fashionable, and later than is wise.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Fall into step with him — let him keep pace. [trait: Bold]
Arabella: Give a cool curtsy and walk on. [trait: Reserved]
(IfChoice:0)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: He falls in beside you. Neither speaks; both are aware of it.
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_darcy | desire | +2) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: You pass him with a nod. His eyes follow you the whole length of the lane.
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_darcy | affection | +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_wickham | A Charming Word | Mr Wickham falls in beside you)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Wickham appears at your elbow with a smile made for exactly this moment.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=arabella_frost right=mr_wickham]
Mr-Wickham: Miss Frost — you are the one interesting thing in a very dull county.
Arabella: Flattery so early? You must want something.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Let him talk, and listen for the cracks. [trait: Sharp]
Arabella: Warn him you are not so easily charmed. [trait: Guarded]
(IfChoice:0)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: He talks, and among the charm you catch a bitterness whenever Darcy's name arises.
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_wickham | resentment sharpens whenever Darcy is named) (Relation: mr_wickham | trust | +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: He laughs, delighted. 'A lady with defences. How refreshing.'
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_wickham | desire | +1) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_bingley | An Open Heart | Mr Bingley greets you warmly)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Bingley greets you as though you were an old friend he is delighted to have found.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=arabella_frost right=mr_bingley]
Mr-Bingley: Miss Frost! Is it not the finest morning? I declare Meryton the happiest place in England.
Arabella: You declare that of everywhere, I think.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Ask, lightly, after Jane Bennet. [trait: Kind]
Arabella: Tease him about his easy heart. [trait: Playful]
(IfChoice:0)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: At Jane's name his whole face changes. He is further gone than he knows.
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_bingley | Jane Bennet has caught his whole heart) (Relation: mr_bingley | trust | +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: He laughs without offence. It is impossible to wound a man so good-natured.
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_bingley | affection | +1) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_dw | A Frost Between Them | Darcy and Wickham cross paths)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Darcy and Wickham have met on the road, and neither will bow first.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mr_darcy right=mr_wickham]
Mr-Wickham: Darcy. You are looking as agreeable as ever.
Mr-Darcy: Wickham.
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: One word, and a world of cold in it. Whatever lies between them, it is not small.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Draw closer and mark every look. [trait: Observant]
Arabella: Give them their privacy and pass. [trait: Discreet]
(IfChoice:0)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: You catch the truth beneath the manners: this is an old wound, not a new quarrel.
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_darcy | an old, private grievance with Wickham) (Discovery: mr_wickham | claims Darcy wronged him of a living)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: You walk on. Some enmities are best not witnessed too closely.
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_bj | Two Kind Hearts | Bingley and Jane, lost in talk)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Bingley and Jane have fallen into conversation and forgotten the world entirely.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=jane_bennet right=mr_bingley]
Mr-Bingley: I hope — that is — I do hope we shall dance again soon.
Jane: I should like that very much, Mr Bingley.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Watch how they suit one another. [trait: Warm]
Arabella: Slip away and leave them to it. [trait: Kind]
(IfChoice:0)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: They suit like a key and its lock. If only the world would leave them be.
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_bingley | falls in love as easily as breathing) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_db | A Friend's Counsel | Darcy speaks low to Bingley)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Darcy speaks low into Bingley's ear; Bingley's smile falters, then bravely returns.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mr_darcy right=mr_bingley]
Mr-Darcy: I only counsel you to be certain of the lady's regard before the whole county is.
Mr-Bingley: You are always so careful, Darcy.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Note how Bingley defers to him. [trait: Observant]
Arabella: Interrupt with a bright remark. [trait: Bold]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_darcy | steers Bingley's affections more than he admits) (Relation: mr_darcy | trust | +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: They break apart; Bingley laughs, Darcy does not. But his eyes stay on you.
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_darcy | desire | +1) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_wl | Too Bold by Half | Wickham indulges Lydia)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Lydia hangs on Wickham's arm, laughing far too loud; he indulges her, a man who knows his effect.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=lydia_bennet right=mr_wickham]
Lydia: Oh, you are wicked, Mr Wickham!
Mr-Wickham: Only as wicked as good company makes me, Miss Lydia.
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: This is the sort of thing that ruins a family — and no one here to see it but you.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Break it up and steer Lydia away. [trait: Protective]
Arabella: Let it be seen — and remembered. [trait: Cold]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_wickham | pursues the youngest and most foolish) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Scandal: +2)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_ew | An Easy Charm | Wickham enchants Elizabeth)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Wickham is at his most charming, and Elizabeth listens with evident pleasure.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=elizabeth_bennet right=mr_wickham]
Mr-Wickham: You understand me, Miss Bennet, as few do.
Elizabeth: You make it easy to be understood, sir.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Admire the performance for what it is. [trait: Shrewd]
Arabella: Feel a flicker of jealousy. [trait: Honest]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_wickham | charms by making the listener the centre of the world)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_wickham | desire | +1) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_ec | Between Friends | Elizabeth and Charlotte on marriage)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Elizabeth and Charlotte have their heads together, arguing happiness against security.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=elizabeth_bennet right=charlotte_lucas]
Charlotte: Happiness in marriage is entirely a matter of chance, Lizzy.
Elizabeth: You would not act so yourself, Charlotte.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Side with Charlotte's cold prudence. [trait: Pragmatic]
Arabella: Argue for love, and let them hear it. [trait: Romantic]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1) (Discovery: mr_collins | Charlotte would take even Mr Collins for a home of her own)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_mb | A Mother's Campaign | Mrs Bennet corners Bingley)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Mrs Bennet has cornered Mr Bingley and extols Jane's virtues at a volume the whole road enjoys.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mrs_bennet right=mr_bingley]
Mrs-Bennet: Five daughters, Mr Bingley, and not one so sweet-tempered as my Jane!
Mr-Bingley: I — yes — she is all that is amiable, ma'am.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Rescue him with a graceful diversion. [trait: Gracious]
Arabella: Let your mother run on. [trait: Wry]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_bingley | affection | +2) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Scandal: +2)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_md | A Proud Man Offended | Mrs Bennet slights Darcy)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Mrs Bennet declares Mr Darcy the proudest man in England — well within his hearing.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mrs_bennet right=mr_darcy]
Mrs-Bennet: A most disagreeable man! I quite detest him.
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Darcy's expression does not change, which is somehow worse.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Apologise for the family with quiet wit. [trait: Deft]
Arabella: Privately agree with your mother. [trait: Blunt]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_darcy | trust | +2)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_mj | A Cool Civility | Miss Bingley and Jane)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Miss Bingley is all smiles to Jane's face, and ice behind her eyes.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=miss_bingley right=jane_bennet]
Miss-Bingley: What a sweet gown, Miss Bennet. So brave to wear it twice.
Jane: You are very kind, Miss Bingley.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Return the barb with interest. [trait: Sharp]
Arabella: Stand near Jane in silent support. [trait: Loyal]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +2) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1) (Discovery: mr_bingley | his sisters guard him against the Bennets)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_ej | Sisterly Counsel | Elizabeth and Jane confide)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Jane confides a hope she scarcely dares name; Elizabeth teases, then softens.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=elizabeth_bennet right=jane_bennet]
Jane: Do you think he — no. I must not hope it.
Elizabeth: Hope it, Jane. For once, hope it aloud.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Add your own confidence in return. [trait: Warm]
Arabella: Ask, gently, after Bingley's intentions. [trait: Curious]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_bingley | Jane believes his regard is real)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_de | A Battle of Wits | Darcy and Elizabeth spar)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Darcy and Elizabeth are sparring again — every civility edged like a blade, and both enjoying it.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mr_darcy right=elizabeth_bennet]
Elizabeth: I dearly love a laugh, Mr Darcy.
Mr-Darcy: The wisest of us may be laughed at by a person who makes it their study.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Take Elizabeth's side and best him. [trait: Bold]
Arabella: Note how well they are matched. [trait: Observant]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_darcy | desire | +2) (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_darcy | only truly speaks to those who challenge him)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_wc | A Shrewd Eye | Charlotte watches Wickham)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Charlotte watches Wickham work the room, and is not charmed.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=charlotte_lucas right=mr_wickham]
Charlotte: A man who owes everyone smiles at everyone.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Ask her quietly what she knows. [trait: Curious]
Arabella: Defend Wickham's easy manner. [trait: Contrary]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_wickham | leaves debts wherever the militia is quartered)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_wickham | trust | +1) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_lm | Folly Meets Disdain | Lydia prattles at Miss Bingley)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Lydia prattles of officers and lace; Miss Bingley's smile grows thinner by the word.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=lydia_bennet right=miss_bingley]
Lydia: There are to be a dozen officers at the assembly — a dozen!
Miss-Bingley: How very... diverting for you.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Steer Lydia off before she shames you all. [trait: Prudent]
Arabella: Enjoy Miss Bingley's discomfort. [trait: Wicked]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_em | Claws Beneath Silk | Elizabeth and Miss Bingley)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Miss Bingley remarks that Elizabeth's eyes are 'much improved by exercise' — a mile of mud, she means.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=miss_bingley right=elizabeth_bennet]
Elizabeth: How kind of you to notice, Miss Bingley.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Add your own polished barb. [trait: Sharp]
Arabella: Refuse to play the game. [trait: Composed]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +2) (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_le | An Unheeded Warning | Elizabeth warns Lydia)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Elizabeth begs Lydia to have some care for her reputation; Lydia only laughs.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=elizabeth_bennet right=lydia_bennet]
Elizabeth: You will make us all ridiculous, Lydia.
Lydia: You are grown so dull, Lizzy!
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Support Elizabeth's warning. [trait: Sensible]
Arabella: Fear where Lydia's folly leads. [trait: Wary]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Allure: +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_wickham | Lydia is exactly the ruin he could use)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_bm | Brother and Sister | Miss Bingley presses her brother)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Miss Bingley presses her brother about Netherfield — whether he means to stay the winter.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=mr_bingley right=miss_bingley]
Miss-Bingley: Surely you tire of the country by now, Charles.
Mr-Bingley: On the contrary — I have never liked a place so well.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Listen for what keeps him here. [trait: Observant]
Arabella: Remind Bingley how fine the neighbourhood is. [trait: Warm]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Discovery: mr_bingley | his sisters would remove him from Meryton if they could)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_bingley | affection | +1)
(EndIf)

(Situation: enc_jm | Counting Chickens | Mrs Bennet marries Jane off early)
[ui:narrative]
Narrative: Mrs Bennet has all but married Jane to Bingley and settled the wedding-clothes.
[ui:cast layout=convo_two]
[cast: left=jane_bennet right=mrs_bennet]
Mrs-Bennet: Three thousand a year, and the lace from town!
Jane: Mama — please — say no more.
[ui:multi]
(Choice:2)
Arabella: Gently hush Mrs Bennet for Jane's sake. [trait: Kind]
Arabella: Wince and withdraw. [trait: Weary]
(IfChoice:0)
Mechanics: (Relation: mr_bingley | trust | +1)
(EndIf)
(IfChoice:1)
Mechanics: (Scandal: +1)
(EndIf)
